notes.title: Welcome to RDS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238887/2cd3e96ab15b420b42b83df56470070a9956d28b.png[/img]

We've finally added player model to TAR! Now you'll be able to see your self on the cameras and your shadow.
Have fun and be careful!

[list]
[*] Update for the Demo build is available now!
[/list]

Also join our Discord server to learn more about the game
[url=https://discord.gg/5QsNycjU2N][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238887/558a8ec6c10154180a069741e3f155fcc822c5e2.gif[/img][/url]

notes.notes:
